hypothesis: Given one independently reviewed bounded entity-level DP summary, pure postprocessing with AIM or MST compression may reduce serialized bytes versus its uncompressed form while preserving downstream utility within the preregistered margin. No private-data read or extra privacy loss is permitted after summary creation.
null_hypothesis: Neither compressed arm improves bytes at matched downstream utility; retain the uncompressed reference and make no mechanism claim.
no_win_rule: No arm wins unless an independent accountant review, identical mechanism and adjacency, exact epsilon/delta match, held-out source/model evaluation, utility noninferiority, and validity/compatibility gates all pass. Otherwise preserve the negative or blocked result.

design.contribution_bound: must be fixed and independently reviewed before any private access; currently absent
design.mechanism: one frozen Gaussian mechanism implementation and one frozen bounded summary definition shared by every arm
design.matched_privacy: identical adjacency, contribution bound, mechanism hash, epsilon, delta, clipping/bounds provenance, and complete composed access history across arms
design.postprocessing: candidate transforms receive only the already produced bounded entity-DP summary; all source-derived preprocessing, selection, serialization length, status, metrics, failures, and retries must be included in the reviewed composition before any access
design.primary_measure: serialized summary bytes at utility no worse than the uncompressed arm by more than utility_margin
design.invalid_or_failed_artifacts: retain the original artifact and outcome; include failure/status/length observability in the privacy ledger
